scoring_justification: The main claim is the nonlinear MAE trend and its reversal under electric field, not exact absolute values; structural checks on monotonicity and sign of slopes capture the essential physics without requiring precise DFT energies, which vary with pseudopotential/functional choices.

outputs.description: Magnetic anisotropy energy (MAE) as a function of applied electric field, computed from total-energy differences of DFT+SOC calculations under seven charge conditions.
Number of electrons on the interfacial Fe atom Fe(3) adjacent to the right MgO layer, extracted from DFT charge density as a function of electric field.

output_contract.notes: The scoring checker verifies structural trends: for mae_vs_field.csv the MAE must increase under positive fields and exhibit a reversal (increase after an initial decrease) under negative fields; for noe_fe3_vs_field.csv the electron count must show the opposite correlated trend. Absolute values are accepted within a broad range expected from using open-source DFT, but the nonlinear pattern is the primary criterion.

steps.description: Check that MAE vs field exhibits a single minimum with decreasing then increasing trend when sorted by field.
Check that NOE on Fe(3) vs field exhibits a single maximum (increase then decrease) when sorted by field.
